title: SonicForge voices
description:
The character voices that exist, plus the built-in preset speakers. Each entry carries the emotions it can produce (emotion_choices) and whether emotion is chosen by name (supports_emotion). Pick the voice_id here before making any line.

A design voice also carries the three things that define it — description, anchor_text and seed. Give sonic.voice.create the same three and you get the same voice back, byte for byte; change any one of them and you get a different person. Use this to rebuild a character whose sample was lost, or change only the seed to try another person in the same style.

It creates nothing — sonic.voice.create makes a voice, sonic.generate speaks with one.
